verdict.rationale: Pylon documents no sandbox or isolated test environment separate from production data. The AI-agent 'simulate an interaction' feature is a preview/dry-run of agent behavior, not sandbox data isolation. Assigning agents to selected issues is only a scoping control. The API's 'Test it' runner explicitly executes against the US/EU production servers, as those are the spec's only servers.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can test against a sandbox environment without touching production data

citations.quote: Simulate an interaction with the AI and see how it handles different questions.
